value.name: host
value.description: Hostname or IP address of your cctvQL server.

value.name: port
value.description: Port the cctvQL REST API listens on.

value.name: api_key
value.description: Optional API key. Set CCTVQL_API_KEY on the cctvQL server to enable authentication.

value.name: scan_interval
value.description: How often (in seconds) to poll cctvQL for new events.

value.name: auto_enrich
value.description: When true, cctvQL is automatically queried on every Viseron object detection event and the result is stored and dispatched as a cctvql_enrichment event.
